control: 1024 async graph computations then backend synchronize; no timing events
event: begin on actual backend stream, 1024 async graph computations, end on backend stream, backend synchronize, then event elapsed
scope: one contiguous MUL_MAT graph repeated 1024 times per batch; direct CUDA backend; one host thread; graphs OFF; hot reused buffers
timing_unit: batch envelope, with derived per-graph amortized time explicitly not a single-kernel latency

correctness.reference: dequantized synthetic weight, double accumulation against original F32 input
correctness.scope: final output after every first/warmup/formal batch, outside timing; intermediate outputs overwritten and not individually checked
correctness.path_scope: Q5_0 K896/1024 M1/2/4 N4096 only; Q8_0 uses original math gate
correctness.rationale: Q5_0 activation Q8_1 half scale and half original warp sum correction omitted by mathematical reference; bounded numerical budget, not universal kernel tolerance

quality_gates.cuda_and_ggml_status: all submissions and final sync success; prewait event query permits cudaErrorNotReady
quality_gates.identity: required identities present, full file and loaded native DLL path/hash match, execution pre/post locks pass
quality_gates.event: finite strictly positive batch milliseconds and completed end query
quality_gates.qpc: all boundaries ordered with positive frequency; raw derivations checked
quality_gates.repeats: 30 formal + 5 warmup + 1 first batch per mode; 1024 submissions each
quality_gates.numerics: Q5_0 source path threshold; original mathematical errors retained; Q8_0 unchanged
quality_gates.validation: K1024 aligned controls predeclared as held-out validation; no threshold selection or fitting
quality_gates.event_host_containment: event batch duration <= enclosing host wall + max(10000 ns, two QPC ticks); coarse invalid-evidence guard only

run_order: protocol order; even config index event then control, odd index control then event; one process each
old_failure_retained: All prior probe failures retained; this is a new numerical contract and new run only
background_load_policy: Known LLM, probe, simulator or hash process blocks start; WDDM compute-apps can list desktop graphics, so retain all listed processes and declare exclusive GPU access unverified; no process is killed; frozen quality gates determine rejection
evidence_revalidation: summary checks frozen file hashes, raw digest binding, reruns complete raw audit, and rederives every quality assessment
experiment: predeclared longer batch window; same grid and gates; no isolated-kernel inference
